earnings.title: Dollar Tree, Inc. Reports Third Quarter Results
highlights: Comparable store net sales increased 4.6% on top of 4.2% last year
Comparable store net sales growth included a 3.8% increase in traffic and a 0.8% increase in average ticket
Diluted EPS of $1.24, including $0.42 of cost related to the net impact of tariff reinvestments
Adjusted EPS of $1.16, including $0.42 of cost related to the net impact of tariff reinvestments

quotes.text: Our third quarter results show the strength of Dollar Tree’s value proposition and the progress we’ve made to improve the customer experience.

outlook: Increasing fiscal 2026 adjusted EPS outlook to a range of $8.05 to $8.25 including an approximate $0.65 benefit related to the net impact of tariff refunds
Q4 fiscal 2026 outlook of 3% to 4% comparable store net sales growth and adjusted EPS of $2.46 to $2.66 including an approximate $0.25 cost related to tariff refund reinvestments
Fourth quarter adjusted diluted EPS is expected to be in the range of $2.46 to $2.66, including an approximate $0.25 cost impact related to tariff refund reinvestments.

items.heading: Risks associated with merchandise supply could adversely affect our financial performance.
Higher costs and disruptions in our supply chain could have an adverse impact on our sales and profitability.
Our growth is dependent on our ability to increase sales in existing stores.
Our growth is dependent on our ability to expand our square footage profitably.
Our sales and profitability are affected by our product assortment and customer response to the mix of products we sell.
Changes in economic conditions or consumer spending habits could impact our sales or profitability.
